_note: Historical context for the contributors whose Bani is recorded in Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. 'name' matches the corpus author string exactly so the UI can join live Ang/line data. Every date and region is taken from the cited 'sources' (chiefly The Encyclopaedia of Sikhism, Punjabi University Patiala, and Encyclopaedia Britannica); a fact the sources do not settle is null, never guessed, and 'circa' marks the uncertain. region_point is an approximate representative place. Every entry stays review: 'pending' until a scholar signs it (gate G3). Never a ranking.
